method: Added regression overlay against unchanged b35f96e8 application source. The regression test itself is committed in the repair source below; this is not a rerun of the old hosted suite.
finding: [P2] Closing an unconfirmed original left directory unit actions active. Opening unit 202 could race with recovering unit 101 and leave unit 202 fields under the original unit 101 retry action.
observed: Expected Unit identifier 101; received 202. No second mutation was sent by the reproducer.
disposition: Block opening other units while an original exists, at both the operation guard and native directory controls. Preserve the original key/body and existing retry action.
